cohort: 195 HIV-exposed uninfected (HIV-EU) infants born in Kingston, Jamaica, between January 1, 2004 and December 31, 2006
finding: HIV-exposed uninfected infants in Jamaica had a higher incidence of infectious diseases but normal growth compared to published community controls.
mod_finding: HIV-exposed uninfected infants born via cesarean section had significantly higher hospitalization rates from lower respiratory tract infections and sepsis than published community controls.
